# Consonant SVGs

Drop **consonant** glyph files here.

- Use **relative** references only (loaded from `js/composer.js` as `assets/svg/consonants/<name>.svg`).
- Prefer consistent viewBox/size across glyphs so placement rules can align prefix, root, suffix, etc.
- Document your filename convention (e.g. Unicode scalar, Wylie, or custom id) in a comment or table when you add files.

Nothing is required for v0 scaffold preview.
